title: pubdoc project.yml
description: A document project: the parts one purpose needs, the variants (audiences) and layouts (template or exporter, and format) each doc is rendered in, the review steps before publication, and the places it publishes to. Checker, place, template and exporter names are pubdoc's; `pubdoc check` checks them and every cross-reference.

purpose.description: What the project is for, in a sentence.

parts.description: The kinds of document a doc of this project holds, by name.

required.description: Whether every doc must supply this part.

starts-from.description: A shared part, shared/<name>/<part>.md, that a doc uses as-is when it supplies no file of its own.

contributors.description: GitHub logins that write and edit docs.

reviewers.description: Accounts that may sign off a human review step.

variants.description: Audiences, by name: what a doc includes and emphasises for each.

layouts.description: How a part is rendered, by name: a pubdoc template or an exporter, and the format it makes.

template.description: A template pubdoc carries, by name, or a template directory of this repository: a path relative to the project's directory, which a / marks (./templates/mine, ../templates/mine).

publish.description: Where rendered layouts go, and who may read them there.

corpus.description: The corpus that signs this project's version publets, its path relative to the project's directory. The repository's pubdoc.yml gives the default.

storage.description: Where approved renders are stored. The repository's pubdoc.yml gives the default.

tenant.description: The storage tenant approved renders go to.

key.description: The corpus's signing key: the one verify trusts.

review.description: Ordered review steps between draft and publication. A step with both automatic checkers and human reviewers needs both to pass.

place.description: A place name from pubdoc's registry.
